gloss: to not recognize (because of a change); to look completely different

definitions.gloss: to look so changed as to be unrecognizable; to mistake for someone else
definitions.explanation: To fail to recognize a person or thing because it has changed so much, nearly always as praise for an improvement: a grown-up child, a renovated house. Mostly in {見違|みちが}えるほど and {見違|みちが}えるように.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{見違|みちが}えるほど⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧になった。
examples.english: The room is so clean it looks like a different place.

examples.japanese: ⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧⟦{甥|おい}→甥：13525_oi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{見違|みちが}えるよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦なっていて→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧だ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{分|わ}からなかった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: My nephew had grown so much since I last saw him that at first I didn't know who he was.

notes:
Transitive and ichidan: {見違|みちが}える, {見違|みちが}えた. The change is usually for the better; for simply mistaking one thing for another, use ⟦{見間違|みまちが}える→見間違える：21106_mimachigaeru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見違|みちが}えるほど: so much that it is unrecognizable
- {見違|みちが}えるよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: to change beyond recognition
- {見違|みちが}えた⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧: I hardly recognized you (a compliment)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見間違|みまちが}える→見間違える：21106_mimachigaeru⟧: to mistake A for B (a plain error, no praise)
